532:t_2:220.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're talkative today. Or is that to cover your embarrassment over failing the mission?」

532:t_2:221.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I really do get thrown off when I'm around you.」

532:t_2:222.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you're trying to erase me over that...! And you call yourself the void? Don't make me laugh!」

532:t_2:224.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, but dying to skip out on my debts isn't my style!」

532:t_2:225.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That strong will of yours... is that your power?」

532:t_2:226.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Embarrassing as it is to admit, yeah.」

532:t_2:227.en:
$n
「$$クロウ$$! I'm coming over there now!!」

532:t_2:231.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You're right, as you pointed out. For me to remain myself, your existence is an obstacle.」

532:t_2:232.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But for now, I'll go after that one.」

532:t_2:233.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Well, looks like I got off with my life, for now.」

532:t_2:235.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm fine. I'm alive and kicking.」

532:t_2:237.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah... That bastard in the flesh is even more of a bottomless pit than when he's in his machine.」

532:t_2:238.en:
$n
「His subordinates are closing in on $$神根島$$. Let's hurry.」

532:t_2:239.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Those who send off life... the $$鬼宿$$, huh...」

532:t_2:240.en:
$$クロウ$$
(That guy's carrying something of his own, it seems...)

532:t_3:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

532:t_3:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You're going to tell us, $$ゼロ$$. What you saw in those ruins.」

532:t_3:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm no different from everyone else.」

532:t_3:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What the $$集合無意識$$ showed us was an image of the future of despair that each of us carries.」

532:t_3:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It might have been a prediction of the future, a warning or an invitation from someone... It must have taken all sorts of forms.」

532:t_3:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Could that be what's behind the anxiety that $n and I have been feeling?」

532:t_3:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... It is also the future spoken of by those who touched the $$黒の英知$$ and by Colonel $$シャア$$, who became a $$特異点$$.」

532:t_3:11.en:
$$レド$$
「What awaits us ahead is despair...」

532:t_3:15.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Something that can't be changed... fate...」

532:t_3:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Do you give up because it's predetermined?」

532:t_3:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll struggle until the very last moment...!」

532:t_3:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I won't accept a predetermined fate...! I'll overturn it...! That is the miracle I create!」

532:t_3:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What about the rest of you? If we can't win anyway, will you give up here?」

532:t_3:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「Worrying about the outcome of a battle that hasn't been fought is foolish.」

532:t_3:24.en:
$$マオ$$
「Right. A soldier thinks about how to win, instead of lamenting a lost battle.」

532:t_3:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「The moment you fall into despair is the real defeat.」

532:t_3:26.en:
$$レド$$
「There are things we must do before we give up.」

532:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「So, let's do it, then. Let's take on that future of despair.」

532:t_3:28.en:
$n
「We fight to overcome it. That's how it's been until now, and how it will be from now on.」

532:t_3:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I guess it was pointless to even ask.」

532:t_3:30.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We're not so naive that we'd fall for your scare tactics.」

532:t_3:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「But what do we do...? In the end, what we learned never went beyond the realm of images.」

532:t_3:32.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The being that carved the $$烙印$$ into us... and the one who brings the future of despair...」

532:t_3:33.en:
$n
「So it really is connected to the fundamental calamity we saw out in space...」

532:t_3:36.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Looks like you sensed something in those ruins.」

532:t_3:38.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Someone who claims to be a god... I know about that.」

532:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a rare occurrence. For $$キリコ$$ to speak up on his own.」

532:t_10:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It means we're in a situation that calls for it.」

532:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And what is the reason $$ゼロ$$ has gone out of the way to pay me a visit?」

532:t_10:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I heard that $$モーム$$, being a robot, also caught a glimpse of a future of despair through the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_10:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「AG... I wanted to see what you, who come from a world different from ours, would see there.」

532:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「P-please spare me! A future of despair is, frankly, a definite no thanks!」

532:t_10:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The answer I expected. I knew it was a mistake to expect anything from you.」

532:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, exactly! As expected of $$ゼロ$$, so very wise!」

532:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, now that we've finished talking, let's do one! Let's give it our all again today...!」

532:t_10:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll decline today. If you had gone to the ruins with us, I might have gone along with it.」

532:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I'll let it go. $$ゼロ$$ has already said it once, after all.」

532:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Besides, I got sick and tired of futures of despair a long time ago.)

533:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What's the situation in the surrounding area?」

533:t_000:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I can't confirm any signs of enemy reactions.」

533:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「There should have been Imperial units stationed across this entire $$神根島$$ area...」

533:t_000:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There are signs of fighting...」

533:t_000:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Someone must have eliminated the Empire's units that were guarding this island.」

533:t_000:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...We can't afford to lose time. We land immediately.」
